statements.subject: peer
statements.description: The sending TCP peer must regularly transmit at least one octet of new data (if available), or retransmit to the receiving TCP peer even if the send window is zero, in order to "probe" the window.
actions: transmit at least one octet of new data or retransmit to receiving TCP peer

statements.subject: tcp
statements.description: Probing of zero (offered) windows MUST be supported (MUST-36).

statements.subject: tcp
statements.description: A TCP implementation MAY keep its offered receive window closed indefinitely (MAY-8).
actions: maintain receive window advertisement at zero indefinitely

statements.subject: connection
statements.description: As long as the receiving TCP peer continues to send acknowledgments in response to the probe segments, the sending TCP peer MUST allow the connection to stay open (MUST-37).

statements.subject: peer
statements.description: When the receiving TCP peer has a zero window and a segment arrives, it must still send an acknowledgment showing its next expected sequence number and current window (zero).
actions: send ACK containing next expected sequence number and window = 0

statements.subject: timer
statements.description: The transmitting host SHOULD send the first zero-window probe when a zero window has existed for the retransmission timeout period (SHLD-29) (Section 3.8.1), and SHOULD increase exponentially the interval between successive probes (SHLD-30).

statements.subject: timer
statements.description: The transmitting host SHOULD send the first zero-window probe when a zero window has existed for the retransmission timeout period (SHLD-29) (Section 3.8.1), and SHOULD increase exponentially the interval between successive probes (SHLD-30).
actions: increase interval between successive zero-window probes exponentially
